data.gender_notes: Awwazah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘awwaza’, meaning to guide or lead. This name is a reflection of a person's spiritual journey and guidance from Allah. The name Awwazah carries the meaning “The Guided One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Awwazah usually hope their child will grow to embody the guided one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Awwazah total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

The name Awwazah represents the belief in the divine guidance from Allah throughout life, emphasizing the importance of seeking and following Allah's will. This spiritual significance is a continuous reminder of the divine relationship between Allah and the individual, and the importance of staying on the righteous path in life.
